title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: each faithful arm's chosen CQL configuration on training seeds 2 to 4
description: The configurations exp-lcf-cost-search-316 chose by the mean over training seeds 0 and 1, trained exactly as in exp-lcf-cost-315 on training seeds 2, 3 and 4: paper (neto1 v1's seven values) with CQL weight 0.1, free (seven free latents) with CQL weight 0.01, both at actor learning rate 1e-4 (critic 1e-3) for 60,000 updates. The policies (lcf-ARM-cCQL-lr1e-4-n60k-sSEED) join seeds 0 and 1 in the report run on links the search did not touch.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; LR=1e-4; UPDATES=60000; CQL=0.1; [ "$ARM" = free ] && CQL=0.01; O="$OUT/lcf-$ARM-c$CQL-lr$LR-n$((UPDATES / 1000))k-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson cql "$CQL" --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson updates "$UPDATES" --argjson seed "$SEED" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2: ({algo: "expliccit-v1", action: "multiplier", reward: "sage", reward_alignment: "same", action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, cql_alpha: $cql, expliccit_lrs: [$lr, (10 * $lr)], steps: $updates} + (if $arm == "free" then {inputs: "raw", encoder: "free"} else {} end))}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcf-*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
